text:
We checked “2 missing links” and found one issue in the InDesign file that is likely causing the problems in Frontify, plus 1 that may change how it looks. Here’s what to change:

Likely causing the problems

1. Linked image missing from the package
The document links to an image that isn’t in the package, so Frontify can’t show it.
Where: images “monobrand-main-logo-black.eps” (page 1) and “person-holding-wooden-toothbrush-3737592.jpg” (page 1)
• Relink any missing images in Window > Links.
• Package again with File > Package with "Copy Linked Graphics" checked.
Learn more

May change how it looks

2. Document has bleed
Bleed is added to every export, which is right for print templates but usually unwanted for digital ones.
Current bleed: 3 mm on all sides
• For a digital template, set bleed to 0 in File > Document Setup > Bleed and Slug. For print templates, bleed is fine.
Learn more

Once that’s done, package the document again with File > Package, zip the package folder and upload it to Frontify.
